title: Map iteration methods
starterCode:
const map = new Map()
map.set("a", 1)
map.set("b", 2)
map.set("c", 3)
const keys = [...map.keys()]
const values = [...map.values()]
const entries = [...map.entries()]
return { keys, values, entries }
